title: ojd --json output
description: The JSON output of one command of the command-line tool.

oneOf.description: A token, shown once, and its grant.

controller.description: The controller whose record was layered, as a vendor and product pair.

defaultsFile.description: The defaults patch file of the user.

profile.description: The active profile whose stick values the profile rows show.

defaultsProblem.description: Why the defaults patch file was ignored.

key.description: A record tuning key, or for a profile row the profile file of the value.

layer.description: The layer that set the value, lowest first.

families.description: The protocol families whose drivers read the key.

alsoListedBySystem.description: Whether the system also lists the controller as a second, silent controller.

ownedByAnotherClient.description: Whether another client holds the controller's USB interface exclusively.

power.description: The latest power state the controller reported.

unit.description: The persistent unit identifier, stable while the controller stays on the same port.

waitsForGuidePress.description: Whether the controller has sent no input yet and waits for a press of its home button.

controllerShow.description: A connected controller, or with kind UnservedController a connected device that OJD does not serve.

reason.description: Why OJD does not serve the device.

draftCommand.description: The command that drafts a record; present for a HID pad.

captureCommand.description: The command that captures the packets; present when the reason is NoProtocolMatch.

digitalTriggers.description: The triggers the controller reports only as buttons.

serverSource.description: Where the server setting comes from: a record layer, the default, or a route.

power.description: The latest power state the controller reported.

publication.description: Whether a virtual device publishes the controller.

failure.description: The text of the failed send.

lastAttemptedNanoseconds.description: System uptime of the last send to the virtual device.

lastCompletedNanoseconds.description: System uptime of the last send the virtual device accepted.

reason.description: Why no virtual device publishes the controller.

inputMapping.description: Where the HID usage map comes from.

record.description: The effective record for the controller's model.

serving.description: How OJD serves the controller, as the serving policy decides it.

heldByAppleDriver.description: True when Apple's driver holds the controller; a claim then activates the extension.

tuning.description: The effective tuning of the record, as applied.

unit.description: The persistent unit identifier, stable while the controller stays on the same port.

overrideScope.description: Whether override is the controller's own choice or its model's.

controllerWatch.description: One watch line for a controller, a first press, or an output state.

oneOf.description: With --all, one watch line per line.

timings.description: The newest frames of each connected controller, oldest first, with a summary.

exitCode.description: The exit code of a command-line error.

wire.description: The wire value of a remapping error.

lines.description: The number of log lines written.

logShow.description: A snapshot of each log, or with -f one line per log line.

generate.description: The documents a generator script returned, with what happened to each file.

output.description: The folder that received the files; absent when the command wrote none.

document.description: The document as an XML property list; present when the command wrote no file.

file.description: The name of the file of the document.

migrate.description: Each file that migrate scanned, with its verdict.

detail.description: Why the file failed or is foreign.

file.description: The file's location below the scanned folder.

verdict.description: What became of the file; Migrated also means a dry run would convert it.

value.description: The value at the key in the profile file.

profileValidate.description: A profile check result: the profile's properties, or a validity flag and a problem.

differences.description: The fields of the controller state that differ.

actual.description: The parsed value of the field, as JSON text.

expected.description: The expected value of the field, as JSON text.

missingSections.description: The record sections the draft cannot fill; empty when none is missing.

sharedAPIVersion.description: The version of the JSON output format.

reason.description: The endpoint error code of the refusal.

name.description: The grant the token belongs to.

origin.description: The origin of the page that sent the token.

reason.description: The endpoint error code of the refusal.

sharedConfigChange.description: A tuning key and its value before a configuration change.

controller.description: The controller model whose record the change writes, as a vendor and product pair.

created.description: Whether the change creates the user file.

file.description: The user file the change writes or removes.

previous.description: The effective value before the change.

removesFile.description: Whether the change removes the file because it leaves no key in a patch.

sharedControllerServer.description: A model's server setting before and after a claim or release.

created.description: Whether the change creates the user record file.

file.description: The user record file the change writes.

pointer.description: The aim of a pointing device, such as the Wii Remote IR camera; positive y is down.

sharedControllerWatchEvent.description: A watch line: a controller added, modified, or deleted.

sharedExclusiveOwner.description: The client that holds the controller's USB interface exclusively.

name.description: The process name, or the class of the kernel driver.

sharedFrameTimingSummary.description: What the frame window of one controller says about stutter.

lastSeconds.description: The number of seconds before the answer that the window covers.

spanNanoseconds.description: From the first to the last Read stamp of the window.

thresholdNanoseconds.description: The read interval above which a read counts as a stall.

count.description: The read intervals that are stalls.

sharedTuningKey.description: A tuning key of a controller record or of the defaults patch.

sharedServer.description: Who serves the controller model: the system, or OpenJoystickDriver through a virtual gamepad.

sharedWatchedController.description: A controller, with its latest input and output.

fileName.description: The stale .json file of an earlier alpha.

leftOut.description: The parts of the profile that the target controller cannot take, each with the sources it lacks.

skippedControls.description: The controls of the template that the controller lacks, so the template left them unbound.

sharedStatus.description: The result of an action that leaves no object to print.

sharedVirtualFeedLine.description: One output command that the host sent to the virtual gamepad, oldest first.

sharedVirtualSDL.description: The SDL mapping of a virtual gamepad profile.

mapping.description: One SDL mapping line: the GUID, the name, the bindings, and platform:Mac OS X, ending in a comma.

worksWithDefaultSDLHints.description: Whether SDL recognizes the profile with its default hints, as the profile's definition states.

sharedVirtualW3C.description: The W3C Gamepad description of a virtual gamepad profile.

sharedVirtualOutput.description: What the virtual gamepad last reported, after stick transfer and remapping.

buttons.description: Bit n is HID button n + 1.

commandLineTool.description: The state of the command-line tool link that the app installs.

paused.description: Whether a Pause has the controller pass through unmapped.

listenerFailure.description: The record of a stopped request listener.

message.description: The code with its localized text, the error number and the time.

current.description: Whether the process that recorded the failure is still running.

listenerFailureProblem.description: The localized problem with the record of a listener failure.

mappings.description: One entry per virtual gamepad profile, with only the member of the requested format.

overrideScope.description: Whether override is the controller's own choice or its model's.

sdl.description: The SDL mapping of the controller's live virtual gamepad.

w3c.description: The W3C Gamepad description of the controller's live virtual gamepad.
